examples.en: Which of our righteous deeds was ever safe? Even if I, Tang Rou, am afraid, the Pear-Blossom Needles at my waist certainly aren't.
examples.zh: 我们哪次行侠仗义没有危险？就算我唐柔害怕，我腰间的暴雨梨花针可不会怕。

examples.en: Tang Rou, there's something I must tell you—beware of a person holding an umbrella.
examples.zh: 唐柔，有句话我一定嘱咐你——小心一个撑伞的人。
